Hey all . I've been in this server for a bit but never submitted any times. Decided to have a go at it this tour. I'm gonna start submitting more times and stuff just to kinda see my progression, I'd like to be able to get the times you guys get someday haha. Although right now my priority is ranked cup, so if I got a close group I probably won't grind TT much. 

This is my final time for Royal Raceway, splits 48.20/48.51. Completely failed the ending lap 2 lol. Was trying to sub 0.50, had my chances but never put the run together. My best lap was 48.19, had a few 48.2s and 48.3s, and got to a point where I was relatively consistently getting 48.4s and 48.5s. This was actually my first time really doing automatic drift lol, I've really only ever done manual/smart steering. I constantly had to restart cause I'd accidentally steer instead of drift, or I'd release a MT too early cause I guess my thumb veered too far from the drift button and the game thought I wanted to steer or something, idk. It was a fun one to grind though, but I got a ways to go . I started with a 1:38.40 with manual/no SS after a few attempts, had chances to shave 2 seconds off that but couldn't quite get there, ah well.
